title: No Sleep Till Brooklyn

[00:10.80]Brooklyn

[01:35.46]No sleep 'til
[01:40.96]No sleep 'til Brooklyn
[01:45.95]No sleep 'til Brooklyn
[01:50.56]Ain't seen the light since we started this band
[01:53.12]So, MCA, get on the mic, my man!
[01:55.89]Born and bred in Brooklyn USA
[01:57.83]They call me Adam Yauch, but I'm MCA
[02:00.45]Like a lemon to a lime, a lime to a lemon
[02:02.94]I sip the Def ale with all the fly women

[02:08.14]Autographed pictures and classy hoes
